description: Ink Manager (Swatches panel menu > Ink Manager): set each ink's type, neutral density, trapping sequence, alias and conversion to process, convert all spot inks to process, and use standard Lab values for spots; returns every ink with its settings and solidity. With no options, lists the inks

allSpotsToProcess.description: All Spots to Process: true converts every spot ink to process, false keeps every spot ink as a spot (applied before per-ink settings)

alias.description: Ink to print this ink as (Ink Alias); an empty string clears the alias

convertToProcess.description: Print this spot ink as process colours

name.description: Ink name, e.g. "Process Cyan" or a spot colour name

useStandardLabForSpots.description: Use Standard Lab Values for Spots, for more accurate display and output of spot colours

name: set_inks
title: Set Inks
